scope: Physical Tab and Enter input on an inactive slide in an independent x64 consumer of the published v7 NuGet package
method: Launched the existing --probe-hero-foreground consumer separately with explicit Dark and Light themes; used physical Tab and Enter through Computer Use and observed the live WinUI index, visible slide, and caller result text
